title: Offline mode launch plan
task: Plan the launch of offline mode for our field-notes app. Target: beta by end of Q1. The team is 4 engineers and 1 designer.

teamConfig.name: Mobile Product Squad
teamConfig.note: Turned off the Designer ↔ Engineer consult to save turns; Critic on Llama 3.3 70B

members.personality: Clear and decisive. Keeps scope tight.
members.responsibleFor: Writes the brief, assigns sections, assembles the final document.

members.personality: Evidence first. Always cites sources, and quotes the uploaded files when they answer the question.

members.responsibleFor: Scope from the user's side, milestones that ship value.

members.personality: Pragmatic. Flags effort and risk early.
members.responsibleFor: Timeline, technical risks, feasibility. Reads the code when a public GitHub repo is linked.

rules.what: Returns finished sections and open questions

brief.goal: Ship an offline mode beta of the field-notes app by the end of Q1, with sync that never loses a note.
brief.audience: The team's engineering and design leads.
brief.assumptions: 4 engineers and 1 designer. The linked repository (example-org/field-notes-app, main) shows how sync works today.
brief.doneWhen: All 7 reviewed sections are approved by the Critic, and anything unresolved is listed under Open questions.

sections.name: Goal
sections.guidance: One or two sentences: the outcome and the deadline.

sections.name: Scope and non-goals
sections.guidance: What is in scope, and explicit non-goals.

sections.name: Milestones
sections.guidance: 3–5 milestones that each ship user value.

sections.name: Owners
sections.guidance: Who owns what. Use [PLACEHOLDER] names, never invent people.

sections.name: Timeline
sections.guidance: Phases with rough dates up to the deadline.

sections.name: Risks
sections.guidance: Top risks, each with a likelihood and a concrete mitigation.

sections.name: Dependencies
sections.guidance: Things that must happen or be decided first.

sections.name: Open questions
sections.guidance: Questions raised during the run that no agent could answer. Not reviewed.

spans.why: A run starts with a brief the user approves before anything else happens.
